note: Manual decisions on top of tools/build_authors.py. Rule: label only writers who self-identified as Trotskyists and did not later break with or renounce Trotskyism. See AUTHORS-CATALOG.md.

hansen.why: Secretary to Trotsky in Coyoacán, then decades a leader of the US SWP and the Fourth International (MIA Hansen archive + ETOL). Self-described Trotskyist.

held-walter.why: German IKD member, Trotsky's secretary in Norway, Fourth International (MIA Held archive). Murdered by the NKVD 1942 as a Trotskyist.

dowson.why: Leader of Canadian Trotskyism (Workers Party/RWP/LSA) for 40 years (MIA Dowson archive).

vitale.why: Chilean Trotskyist historian, Fourth International militant, MIR co-founder (MIA Vitale archive).

bensaid.why: Leader of the French LCR and the Fourth International (USFI); wrote 'Les trotskysmes' from inside the movement (MIA Bensaïd archive).

sejake.why: South African trade unionist who became a Trotskyist (Marxist Workers Tendency / CWI) (MIA Sejake archive).

hadden.why: Leader of the Militant / Socialist Party in Northern Ireland, CWI (Trotskyist) (MIA Hadden archive).

harman.why: Leading IS/SWP (Britain) theoretician; the IST describes itself as part of the Trotskyist tradition (MIA Harman archive).

molyneux.why: SWP (Britain) / IST; author of 'Leon Trotsky's Theory of Revolution'; self-described Trotskyist (MIA Molyneux archive).

rosdolsky.why: MIA bio: 'At the beginning of the thirties, he joined the Trotskyist movement and till the end of his life he identified' with it.

reed-evelyn.why: MIA: 'Member of the American Trotskyist movement' (SWP, lifelong).

hirson.why: MIA: 'South African Trotskyist', organiser for the Workers International League.

burnham.why: Self-ID'd as a Trotskyist in the 1930s; broke with Trotsky in 1940 and renounced Marxism (MIA: 'broke with Trotsky').

shachtma.why: Founder of US Trotskyism; broke with Trotsky in 1940 (Workers Party), later renounced Trotskyism for right social democracy.

morrow-felix.why: SWP Trotskyist until expelled in 1946; MIA notes he then rejected the revolutionary perspective and left Marxism.

draper.why: SWP/FI in 1938-40, then Shachtman's Workers Party and 'Third Camp' Independent Socialism; did not keep the Trotskyist label.

braverman.why: MIA time-boxes it: 'US Trotskyist in 1930s/40s'; left the SWP (Cochranites) in 1953, later Monthly Review.

rawick.why: Trotskyist in youth (SWP/Workers Party), later broke to Johnson-Forest / Facing Reality autonomism.

munis.why: Spanish Trotskyist in the 1930s-40s; broke with the Fourth International in 1948 and repudiated Trotskyism ('For a Second Communist Manifesto').

tagore.why: MIA: favoured Permanent Revolution 'but remained independent of the Fourth International'; no self-ID as Trotskyist.

dunayevskaya.why: Trotsky's secretary and a Trotskyist 1928-1951 (Johnson-Forest), then broke and founded Marxist-Humanism. Not auto-labelled, per the brief.

ciliga.why: MIA: 'sympathizer of the Left Opposition'; later anti-communist. Left Opposition sympathy is not self-ID.

camejo.why: SWP leader into the 1980s, then broke and later joined the Greens.

marcy.why: SWP until 1959, then founded Workers World, which broke with Trotskyism.

boggs.why: Johnson-Forest Tendency inside US Trotskyism, broke in 1951; later independent.

gorman.why: Johnson-Forest Tendency, broke with Trotskyism in 1951.

deutscher.why: Polish Left Oppositionist; opposed founding the Fourth International in 1938 and stayed independent. Trotsky's biographer, not a self-ID'd Trotskyist after 1938.

eastman.why: Translator and supporter of Trotsky, never a member of a Trotskyist group; later anti-communist.

riazanov.why: The only 'Trotskyist' in his MIA text is the Stalinist charge of 1937. Not self-ID.

baracchi.why: MIA: 'joined Trotskyists 1939'. How long he stayed is unconfirmed, so no label yet (follow-up).

serge.why: Left Opposition; broke with Trotsky in the late 1930s; never self-ID'd as a Trotskyist.

rosmer.why: Left Opposition co-founder; broke with Trotsky's organisation in 1930; friend, not a self-ID'd Trotskyist.

nin.why: Left Opposition; broke with Trotsky in 1935 to found the POUM.

levy-benny.why: Gauche Prolétarienne was Maoist; MIA's 'Trotskyist' sits in a list of phases, later Islamist/Judaism. Not labelled.

james-clr.why: Trotskyist 1934-1951 (Johnson-Forest), then broke with Trotskyism. Not auto-labelled, per the brief.

gorkin.why: POUM leader. Broke with Trotsky in the 1930s, later anti-communist. 'Trotskyist' in his MIA archive is article-title text.
